## Privacy and Redaction

Do not include customer personal data, passwords, private keys, raw backups, raw support bundles or unnecessary private network details.

Use sanitised summaries. If a support bundle is needed, confirm it has been checked for secrets before attaching or sharing.

## Customer / Site Reference

Use a safe internal reference, not full personal data:

```text
Customer/site reference:
Installation ID:
Support plan:
```
